used.text: Table 4.1: Limitations of sub-functions of 0x19 ReadDTCInformation The table lists the limitations of the sub-functions of 0x19 ReadDTCInforma- tion Hints: 1.) OBD/WWH-OBD is not supported by the DM. 2.) The sub-function is generally not supported by the DM. 3.) The UDS feature mirror event memory is not supported by the DM. • 0x27 SecurityAccess: – Handling of security access delay timer: The behavior of the Delay_Timer , as described in ISO 14229-1:2020[1] chapter 10.4.1 and table I.1 "State transitions - parameters", that, after a power-up, a single false SecurityAccess attempt in the previous power- cycle already starts the Delay_Timer , is not supported by the DM. Instead, [SWS_DM_00479] is followed. – Persistent Storage of failed attempts to change security level: After each increment of the attempt counter, it shall be persisted to survive accidental or intended resets. Selecting the persistent storage is mandatory in Adaptive Autosar. • 0x29 Authentication: – The DM only implements Authentication with PKI Certificate Exchange (APCE), as described in ISO 14229-1:2020[1] chapter 10.6.2. – Authentication with Challenge-Response (ACR), as described in ISO 14229- 1:2020[1] chapter 10.6.3, is currently out of scope. • 0x2A ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier: Only scheduler type 1 is supported. 63 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics
